title: GHSL Taskflow Agent finds decrypted attachment exfiltration in Signal Android
summary: An unprotected exported package-installer receiver accepts attacker-controlled intents and can launch a malicious activity with URI grants to Signal’s decrypted attachment provider, exposing attachments on affected website builds.
ai_role: The primary advisory explicitly says the Taskflow Agent discovered the issue and a GHSL researcher verified it.
classification_note: The advisory describes exposure conditions and mitigations; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Signal updated its website APK to v8.4.2 on 2026-03-31. The issue affects the website flavor; Play Store and GitHub builds do not register the vulnerable receiver.
